_note: The 20-second 'how it works' film under the hero. Her screenshots and her screen recording are composited in ffmpeg and never sent to a video model; only the two beats with a person in them are generated. Each still names a focus point — the beat opens on the whole phone, eases in there, and holds long enough to read on a phone — and three of the beats carry a step caption. Only three of the six screenshots are used: with two 5s generated beats and a 2s closing hold, the /create flow has about 6.2s, which is three punch-ins at a readable pace or five that flick past unread.
